title: Make it yours
summary: Version 0.32 puts the game's own tools in your hands: everything in it can be changed - while it runs, in Talos, or in mods of your own - and the changes are shared as easily as they are made. Patch 0023 opened the whole game to change: mods that replace or merge into any of its files and a Mod Editor to make them; a full mesh editor in Talos (edit mode, 120 editable shapes, booleans, a knife, loop cuts, curve deform, materials, saves kept as overrides with variants, parts bound to a character's skeleton); an animation editor; particle effects as data with an Effects editor; and the Live Editor (F10), which edits anything in the world while the game runs. It also moved Patch Notes to the title screen, put a tooltip on every control, smoothed turning and animation, slung the rifle on the back and started the browser build in 6-7 seconds. Then curve modeling (patch 0024). Then eCurves (patch 0025).

steps.title: Patch 0023 - Mods, meshes and the Live Editor
steps.text: Mods that change any file of the game and a Mod Editor to make them; a mesh editor, an animation editor and an effects editor in Talos; the Live Editor (F10) for anything in the running world, its edits kept for every thing of that kind. Also: Patch Notes on the title screen, a tooltip on every control (about 215 were missing), smooth turns and mended clips, the slung rifle, and the browser build in 6-7 s instead of up to 140.

steps.title: Patch 0024 - Curve modeling
steps.text: Patch 0024 brings curve modelling to the mesh editor: curves sketched on any surface become solids that stay tied to them, every step editable; a solid can be baked into one clean mesh of quads whose curves are its edges - drag any point and the faces follow, settling into a tidy grid when you let go - with smart dragging and guides, a wireframe view and a preview in the running game.

steps.title: Patch 0025 - ECurves
steps.text: The mesh editor becomes the ECurves editor: every model it opens - characters too - turns into an ECurve object, a collection of solids made of faces, edges and vertices you reshape directly. Models are converted in the background into clean quads with a quality check, characters keep their bones, collections and names, and T-pose, hide weapons, symmetry and mirror work on them.
